coded.vi: UU ketenagakerjaan umum berlaku penuh
coded.vl: The general labor statute applies in full
coded.n: The Employment Act applies in full to manual workers whatever their wage (First Schedule para 1, as substituted from 1 Jan 2023), including in agricultural undertakings. Estate workers paid by the day are guaranteed work on at least 24 days a month (s. 16). Act 446 sets housing and amenity standards for estates over 20 ha. Peninsular only; Sabah and Sarawak have their own Labour Ordinances.
coded.src: Employment Act 1955 ss. 2, 60K (Act A1651, 2022); Sabah Labour Ordinance (Cap. 67) · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf

coded.vi: Upah minimum nasional berlaku
coded.vl: The national statutory minimum wage applies
coded.n: The national minimum wage (RM1,700 a month from 1 Feb 2025; from 1 Aug 2025 for employers with fewer than five workers) applies with no exclusion for agriculture or for foreign workers. Piece-rate and tonnage workers must also receive at least RM1,700.
coded.src: National Wages Consultative Council Act 2011 (Act 732); Minimum Wages Order 2024 · official text: https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputp/2541500/PUA%20376.pdf

coded.vi: Batas jam kerja menurut undang-undang berlaku
coded.vl: Statutory limits on hours apply
coded.n: Limits of 8 hours a day and 45 a week (lowered from 48 by Act A1651) apply, with no exclusion for agriculture. The Director General may allow longer hours on application (s. 60A(1A)), and the Minister may exempt by order (s. 2B).

coded.vi: Tidak dapat pindah tanpa persetujuan majikan
coded.vl: Cannot change without the employer's consent
coded.n: Each employer needs the Director General's prior approval to employ a foreign employee (Employment Act s. 60K), and must report when the worker leaves, absconding included (s. 60KA). A pass stops being valid once its conditions are breached (Immigration Act s. 55B(2)). The rule tying the Visit Pass (Temporary Employment) to one employer, and any transfer procedure, sit in the Immigration Regulations 1963 and in Immigration Department practice, neither readable on the trusted sites. dec.n: Public Prosecutor v. Yim Pek Ha (Nirmala Bonat case)
dec.pe: Nirmala, a domestic worker from Indonesia, was burned with an iron and scalded by her employer in Kuala Lumpur. The court convicted the employer and sent her to prison.
dec.pi: Nirmala, pekerja rumah tangga dari Indonesia, disetrika dan disiram air panas oleh majikannya di Kuala Lumpur. Pengadilan memvonis majikan dan memenjarakannya.

dec.n: Public Prosecutor v. Ambika M.A. Shan (death of Adelina Lisao)
dec.pe: Adelina, a young Indonesian domestic worker, died in Malaysia after being made to sleep outside with a dog and left with untreated wounds. The employer was freed when the prosecution dropped the case, causing protests in both countries.
dec.pi: Adelina, pekerja rumah tangga muda Indonesia, meninggal di Malaysia setelah dipaksa tidur di luar bersama anjing dan lukanya tidak dirawat. Majikan dibebaskan saat jaksa mencabut perkara, memicu protes di kedua negara.

dec.n: Fice Fransina Nenobais v. Lee Hee Chooi
dec.pe: An Indonesian domestic worker in Malaysia went unpaid for almost five years. The labour office refused her claim because she had no valid permit. The courts said she could still claim her wages.
dec.pi: Seorang pekerja rumah tangga Indonesia di Malaysia tidak digaji hampir lima tahun. Kantor ketenagakerjaan menolak tuntutannya karena ia tidak punya izin yang sah. Pengadilan menyatakan ia tetap boleh menuntut upahnya.

dec.n: 93 migrant workers left without jobs on arrival
dec.pe: Ninety-three workers arrived in Malaysia in 2023 and found there were no jobs for them. The Labour Court ordered the employer to pay them, and the High Court agreed.
dec.pi: Sembilan puluh tiga pekerja tiba di Malaysia pada 2023 dan ternyata tidak ada pekerjaan untuk mereka. Pengadilan Ketenagakerjaan memerintahkan majikan membayar, dan Pengadilan Tinggi setuju.
